title: Avadhi's mosquito puzzle
body: Avadhi collected some water from a puddle near her school. Through a hand lens she saw two kinds of small worm-like creatures moving in it. Her teacher told her these were mosquito larvae and pupae. Avadhi wanted to find out which stage comes first after the egg. She separated five larvae into one container and five pupae into another, using the same puddle water in both. She observed both containers every day. After a few days, the creatures in the first container had changed into pupae. Soon after, adult mosquitoes appeared in the second container, rested briefly on the water surface and then flew away. Avadhi noted that the larvae and pupae in both containers kept rising to the water surface again and again. Her teacher reminded the class to cover the containers with a fine net so that no adult mosquito could escape into the school.
